skill.name: seedance
skill.description: Generates structured Chinese prompts for Seedance 2.0 video creation, including references, timing, camera motion, sound, and extension workflows.
skill.summary: Create ready-to-use Seedance 2.0 prompts for short videos and multi-part video plans.
skill.author: songguoxs

content.value_statement: Video creators need structured Chinese prompts for Seedance workflows. This skill builds prompt plans for scenes, references, timing, sound, and extensions.
actual_capabilities: Creates Chinese Seedance 2.0 prompts for text-to-video scenes.
Structures prompts with camera motion, lighting, timing, sound, and dialogue.
Plans reference usage with @image, @video, and @audio style assets.
Builds prompt formats for product ads, short drama, animation, education, and music videos.
Splits videos longer than 15 seconds into extension-ready segments.
Provides variants and material preparation notes for complex requests.
limitations: It does not generate or upload videos by itself.
It relies on the user to provide accurate reference assets and platform settings.
It focuses on Chinese Seedance prompts and may need translation for other tools.
It cannot guarantee final video quality or platform moderation outcomes.

use_cases.title: Plan Product Ads
use_cases.description: Create concise product showcase prompts with camera moves, material details, sound, and reference asset usage.

use_cases.title: Write Short Drama Scenes
use_cases.description: Turn a story idea into timed shots, dialogue, emotions, and sound cues for a short video.

use_cases.title: Build Long Video Segments
use_cases.description: Break a longer concept into Seedance-ready sections with clear continuation points for video extension.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Scene Prompt
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a short text-to-video clip.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Seedance 2.0 prompt in Chinese for a [duration] video about [subject]. Include the main action, setting, camera movement, lighting, sound, and aspect ratio.

prompt_templates.title: Reference Asset Prompt
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request using uploaded images, videos, or audio.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Seedance 2.0 prompt in Chinese using @图片1 as [role], @视频1 as [motion reference], and @音频1 as [sound reference]. Explain how each reference should be used.

prompt_templates.title: Timed Storyboard Prompt
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a 15 second narrative or ad.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 15 second Seedance 2.0 prompt in Chinese for [story or product]. Split the video into timed sections with shot content, camera movement, dialogue, and sound design.

prompt_templates.title: Long Video Extension Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for content longer than 15 seconds.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Seedance 2.0 plan in Chinese for a [total duration] video about [theme]. Split it into segments of 15 seconds or less, and define the continuation point for each extension.

output_examples.input: A 10 second vertical milk tea ad with a warm cafe mood.
output_examples.output: The skill returns a Chinese prompt with product close-ups, steam, hand movement, warm lighting, camera pushes, sound cues, and no unwanted text overlays.

output_examples.input: A 30 second fantasy battle scene for Seedance.
output_examples.output: The skill returns a multi-segment plan with a first 15 second generation, a video extension prompt, and clear ending frames for continuity.

output_examples.input: Use an image reference for a character and a video reference for dance motion.
output_examples.output: The skill assigns the image and video references, states their exact purpose, and writes a prompt that separates character consistency from motion reference.

best_practices: Provide the target duration, aspect ratio, scene goal, and any reference assets before generation.
Ask for timed sections when the video needs dialogue, action beats, or precise pacing.
Review reference labels carefully so each @图片, @视频, and @音频 object has one clear purpose.
anti_patterns: Do not request a vague mood without a subject, action, or scene structure.
Do not mix reference assets without explaining which feature each asset should control.
Do not ask for long videos as one prompt when Seedance requires segmented extension workflows.

faq.question: Does this skill generate the final video?
faq.answer: No. It writes Seedance-ready prompts and planning notes for use on the video platform.

faq.question: What language does the skill use for prompts?
faq.answer: It writes video prompts in Chinese because the source workflow is designed for Seedance 2.0 and 即梦.

faq.question: Can it use uploaded reference assets?
faq.answer: Yes. It can plan how to use image, video, and audio references with clear labels and purposes.

faq.question: Can it help with videos longer than 15 seconds?
faq.answer: Yes. It splits longer videos into shorter segments and writes extension prompts for continuity.

faq.question: What should I provide before using it?
faq.answer: Provide the theme, duration, aspect ratio, target platform use, and any reference materials you plan to upload.

faq.question: Does it enforce Seedance platform limits?
faq.answer: It reminds users about limits described in the skill, but the platform makes the final moderation decision.
